brief.title: Ice and Coin
brief.premise: A guild factotum on a nomad market built into a captured comet must arbitrate the theft of a sealed star-map before the comet's perihelion burn scatters the fleet.
constraints: Ships manoeuvre on sails, tethers and reaction plumes; no energy weapons.

world.name: The Comet Market
world.description: A captured comet hollowed into a rotating bazaar that rides its own orbit, where guilds, pilots and ice-miners trade under burn articles until perihelion scatters them.

locations.name: The Core Vaults
locations.description: Hollowed ice halls near the comet's heart where the ice barons keep their claims.

locations.name: The Tether Docks
locations.description: The sprawl of tethers where ships berth against the comet's slow spin.

locations.name: The Map House
locations.description: The guild house where star-maps are drawn, sealed and registered.

locations.name: The Cinder Gardens
locations.description: Sunward glasshouses in the slag skin where growers farm the perihelion light.

locations.name: The Long Hall
locations.description: The arbitration hall where claims are heard under the burn articles.

factions.name: The Mapmakers' Guild
factions.description: The guild that draws, seals and arbitrates every registered star-map.

factions.name: The Ice Barons
factions.description: Claim-holders who mine the core and buy up tethers before each burn.

factions.name: The Free Pilots' Compact
factions.description: Independent pilots who fly the routes the guilds only chart.

rules.statement: At perihelion every claim is settled or forfeited; nothing litigates through the burn.
A sealed star-map may be opened only by its sealer or by the arbiter of the Long Hall.
Weapons aboard are blades, tools and harpoons; powered arms breach the market's charter.
Every ship pays an ice-tithe for its berth; unpaid tithes cost tether rights.

history.name: The Capture
history.description: Free pilots netted the comet, hollowed its core and founded a market no planet could tax.

history.name: The Map Wars
history.description: Rival charts nearly wrecked the fleet at a perihelion; the guild won the right to seal every route.

history.name: The Pilots' Compact
history.description: The free pilots won arbitration rights in the Long Hall after refusing to fly sealed routes.

conflicts.name: The Stolen Chart
conflicts.description: A sealed map of the perihelion route was stolen and resold; the guild calls it piracy, the pilot who holds it calls it salvage.

conflicts.name: The Tether Grab
conflicts.description: The ice barons are buying up tethers before the burn, stranding pilots who owe ice-tithes.

evidence_summary: The world, cast and storyboard satisfy the brief's nomad comet-market setting; deterministic validators are clean and there are no blocking defects.
